settings.name: USE_METRICS
settings.description: **Enable Metrics:** Set to `yes` to enable collection and retrieval of metrics.

settings.name: METRICS_MEMORY_SIZE
settings.description: **Memory Size:** Size of the internal storage for metrics (e.g., `8192`, `16m`, `32m`).

settings.name: METRICS_MAX_BLOCKED_REQUESTS
settings.description: **Max Blocked Requests:** Maximum number of blocked requests to store per worker. Accepts `k`/`m` shorthand.

settings.name: METRICS_MAX_BLOCKED_REQUESTS_REDIS
settings.description: **Max Redis Blocked Requests:** Maximum number of blocked requests to store in Redis. Accepts `k`/`m` shorthand.

settings.name: METRICS_REDIS_TTL
settings.description: **Metrics Redis TTL:** Seconds before Redis metrics keys expire (`0` = permanent); refreshed each sync so active data never expires, letting abandoned data become evictable under `volatile-lru` so Redis recovers from maxmemory. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: MAX_LRU_HISTORY
settings.description: **Max LRU History:** Per-worker LRU slot count and per-key event-history array cap (block trails, auth trails, etc.). Accepts `k`/`m` shorthand.

settings.name: METRICS_SAVE_TO_REDIS
settings.description: **Save Metrics to Redis:** Set to `yes` to save metrics (counters and tables) to Redis for cluster-wide aggregation.
